update.title: Plugin update
update.help: Choose a ZIP containing a newer version of the same plugin (maximum 20 MiB). The package is checked before showing the version change. Previous files are retained; a failed update keeps the current version. Theme and language availability settings are preserved. A ZIP update does not establish repository provenance.
update.invalidFile: Choose a nonempty ZIP file up to 20 MiB.

catalogUpdates.title: Update from repository
catalogUpdates.help: Select a source, download and verify the package, then confirm the version change. Checking does not install updates.
catalogUpdates.communityHelp: This package comes from a community repository. Confirm that you trust this source before updating.
